dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. Prominent 'O' on the lower right flank features a jagged, high-contrast white perimeter with a sharp gradient transition into a dark center. Dorsal structures show stippled, interlocking light-colored perimeters with high-intensity edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the mid-to-upper dorsal regions between larger annuli. Smaller, discrete high-intensity clusters are scattered toward the posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the prominent lower-right ring, the central mid-dorsal 'C' shape, and the adjacent anterior ring form an obtuse scalene triangle with the widest angle at the central dorsal centroid.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear orange-red mark on the posterior-left dorsal surface near the base of the tail. Small orange-hued feature present on the upper neck region near the right lateral edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-frequency, small-scale micro-annuli pattern present specifically on the neck/cervical region, distinct from the larger macro-topology of the torso.
